rules.statement: A subsequent owner who buys over the head of a tenant can get the benefit of section 2(4)(c) of the Rent Act No 55 of 1980, even if they did not occupy the premises on 1st January 1980, as long as the original owner was in occupation of the premises on that date and let the premises to the tenant after that date.
rules.supporting_quote: Therefore it is abundantly clear that the plaintiff is not estopped from having recourse to the exceptions as laid down in section 2(4)(c) of the Amendment to the Rent Act No 55 of 1980.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 2(4)(c) of the Rent Act No 55 of 1980
